On invocation of EthTSyn_RxIndication the ingress timestamp t2 shall be retrieved from the EthIf via EthIf_GetIngressTimeStamp on ingress of the Pdelay_Req message, if EthTSynHardwareTimestampSupport is set to TRUE. If the StbM does not use the Ethernet controller as source for the Virtual Local Time (refer to parameter StbMLocalTimeHardware in [2]), the EthTSyn shall convert the ingress time stamp to the Virtual Local Time as used in the StbM.
